_readme: Completed seasons only, oldest first. Filled at the end of each season by tools/build_history.py (from Sleeper), or by hand. The season in progress is never listed here; the site adds it from live data. Per team: gm = the GM's Sleeper user ID (the key that follows a GM between franchises), gmName = display name at the time, division = Sleeper division number. champion / runnerUp / third = roster_id (third = winner of the 3rd-place game). divisionWinners = roster_ids. weeklyHigh = [{week, points, rosters}] (a tie lists every roster and splits the prize). pointsLeader = roster_ids with the most regular-season points. prizes = that season's prize amounts, copied from league.json when the season is first written. gmOfYear = roster_id of the league-vote winner: the commissioner types it in after the vote (null until then); reruns keep it. Career earnings on the site are computed from these fields. playerAwards = {opoy, dpoy, roy, pickup, trade}: each a list of {player (Sleeper player ID), roster (roster_id he won it with), points}; opoy/dpoy/roy are computed (most regular-season points as a starter), pickup and trade are typed in by the commissioner and kept on reruns. Player cards show these as the player's honors.
